description:
There are three overlapping concurrent-stream executors plus a dead stub. This
fragmentation is a maintenance and correctness hazard: fixes to one path (the
production one) do not reach the others, and it is not obvious which is live.

- LIVE: benchbox/core/throughput/runner.py:StreamRunner — the real executor
  used by the CLI/adapter throughput path.
- EFFECTIVELY DEAD: benchbox/utils/execution_manager.py:ConcurrentQueryExecutor
  (+ PowerRunExecutor) — config-driven, reachable only through the stubbed
  run_concurrent_streams paths below.
- UNUSED EXTERNALLY: benchbox/core/tpc_patterns.py:StreamExecutor — a full
  concurrent framework instantiated only inside its own module; external
  consumers import only generate_official_benchmark_audit_trail from it.
- NON-EXECUTING STUB: benchbox/core/tpch/streams.py:TPCHStreamRunner.run_stream
  (~lines 431-454) counts `-- Query` comment lines and marks every query
  successful WITHOUT executing SQL. Any path through
  run_concurrent_streams (tpch/streams.py, and the parallel
  tpcds/benchmark/runner.py:988-1011 path) measures nothing real. A test or
  caller that reaches this reports fake success.

Fix: make StreamRunner the single throughput executor; delete or clearly
quarantine the dead/unused executors; and either remove the non-executing
stub or make it raise NotImplementedError so it cannot silently report fake
success.

anti_patterns.dont: delete code that a passing test depends on without first proving the test is asserting fake success (the stub case).

preserves.behavior: The production StreamRunner throughput path behavior.
generate_official_benchmark_audit_trail (the one thing external code imports from tpc_patterns).

prior_art.concept: _project/DONE/unknown/planning/tpc-h-stream-processing-implementation.yaml — the completed item that originally filled these stubs; context for why they exist.
benchbox/core/throughput/runner.py:StreamRunner — the canonical executor to standardize on.
benchbox/core/tpc_patterns.py:StreamExecutor — unused framework to retire or fold in.

verifications.description: No production/test path reaches a non-executing stream stub
verifications.expected: stream tests pass against real or explicitly-not-implemented paths

work_units.notes: grep + call-graph; captured to /tmp/concurrency-consolidation-w0.log. StreamRunner is the only live executor; ConcurrentQueryExecutor/PowerRunExecutor and the tpc_patterns.py framework have zero production callers; TPCHStreamRunner.run_stream and TPCDSBenchmark.run_streams/_execute_single_stream are non-executing comment-counting stubs reachable only from tests.
work_units.summary: Map every caller of each executor and the stub; confirm which are truly reachable in production/tests
Neutralize the non-executing run_stream stub (raise NotImplementedError or route to real execution)
Retire ConcurrentQueryExecutor / PowerRunExecutor and StreamExecutor, or fold their unique value into StreamRunner
Update tests/docs that reference retired paths
